Why is euthanasia acceptable for animals, but not for humans?
Double Standards. It would really make much more sense if it’s reversed because humans are self-aware creatures, they can let others know of their desire to be put out of agony.

It's probably a number of issues, but you could probably base it on the ability to understand your own suffering. When an animal suffers from illness, you can't tell it why it is in pain. It just hurts until it dies horribly. With humans in most cases, even if there is pain and suffering, they can understand why, and can choose to numb it in various ways and experience more complex relationships with people before death. A human can make conscious decisions important to itself and the people around it all the way till the end, while an animal just exists and either enjoys its life or suffers confused pain.

That's the main issue, I think. If we could intelligently communicate with animals what is happening to them, I think maybe things would be different, but that's not our world right now.

Why is farming and slaughtering animals for food acceptable and not for humans?

Humans are given lots more consideration than animals. Animal life is viewed as far less important and so a decision to end it is taken much more readily.
I agree with this fully. Cannibalism should be legalized.
Legalized? It should be encouraged! Mandatory even.

From a pragmatic standpoint, nobody is going to investigate an animal's death. If euthanasia wasn't practised by vets, we'd simply shoot them as we used to. We develop bonds with animals, but in a farm environment, most are either a food source or a tool. A food source necessitates that it must be killed, and nobody has an issue with replacing tools. In the context of pets, society doesn't have the resources to cope with abandoned animals, so the only option is euthanasia. It's hard to argue that an abandoned pet can be euthanised, but a non-abandoned pet shouldn't be.

That all said, I personally wouldn't put a pet down, but I have no compunction killing other animals.
